__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: InfluxDB datasource holding systemd-reports data, configured with Flux as its query language.

description: Dashboard to monitor a node based on data from systemd-report

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Manager.SystemState" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> drop(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Manager.UnitsTotal" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Manager.UnitsByStateTotal" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.state == "failed")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Basic.CPUsOnline" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Basic.PhysicalMemoryBytes" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Basic.SwapBytes" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}" and r._field == "value" and (r._measurement == "io.systemd.Basic.OSRelease.NAME" or r._measurement == "io.systemd.Basic.OSRelease.VERSION" or r._measurement == "io.systemd.Basic.OSRelease.VERSION_ID"))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_start"], columnKey: ["_measurement"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r["io.systemd.Basic.OSRelease.NAME"] + " " + (if exists r["io.systemd.Basic.OSRelease.VERSION"] then r["io.systemd.Basic.OSRelease.VERSION"] else r["io.systemd.Basic.OSRelease.VERSION_ID"])})
  )
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Basic.KernelVersion" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}" and r._field == "value" and (r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootStatus" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootDisabled"))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_start"], columnKey: ["_measurement"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootDisabled"] == "true" then "disabled" else r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootStatus"]}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}" and r._field == "value" and (r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootMethod" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootStatus" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootDisabled"))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_start"], columnKey: ["_measurement"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootDisabled"] == "true" or r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootStatus"] == "not-requested" then "N/A" else r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootMethod"]}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootStrategy" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> drop(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}" and r._field == "value" and (r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.MaintenanceWindowStart" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.MaintenanceWindowDuration"))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_start"], columnKey: ["_measurement"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      totalSec = int(v: r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.MaintenanceWindowDuration"])
      h = totalSec / 3600
      m = (totalSec % 3600) / 60
      s = totalSec % 60
      hs = if h < 10 then "0" + string(v: h) else string(v: h)
      ms = if m < 10 then "0" + string(v: m) else string(v: m)
      ss = if s < 10 then "0" + string(v: s) else string(v: s)
      return {_value: r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.MaintenanceWindowStart"] + " (+" + hs + ":" + ms + ":" + ss + ")"}
    })
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

import "date"
import "strings"

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}" and r._field == "value" and (r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootScheduledTime" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootStatus" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootDisabled"))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_start"], columnKey: ["_measurement"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootDisabled"] == "true" or r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootStatus"] == "not-requested" then "N/A" else strings.split(v: string(v: date.truncate(t: time(v: int(v: r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootScheduledTime"]) * 1000), unit: 1s)), t: ".")[0] + "Z"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

import "date"
import "strings"

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}" and r._field == "value" and (r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootRequestTime" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootStatus" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootDisabled"))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_start"], columnKey: ["_measurement"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootDisabled"] == "true" or r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootStatus"] == "not-requested" then "N/A" else strings.split(v: string(v: date.truncate(t: time(v: int(v: r["org.openSUSE.rebootmgr.RebootRequestTime"]) * 1000), unit: 1s)), t: ".")[0] + "Z"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Basic.CPUUsage" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Basic.PressureAvg10" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.resource + " (" + r.type + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

free = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.DiskSpace.FreeBytes" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "source", "fileSystemType", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "free_bytes"})

size = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.DiskSpace.SizeBytes" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "size_bytes"})

join(tables: {free: free, size: size}, on: ["object"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: now(), _field: r.object + " (" + r.fileSystemType + ", " + r.source + ")", _value: 100.0 * float(v: r.size_bytes - r.free_bytes) / float(v: r.size_bytes) }))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Basic.DiskReadBytes" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Read (" + r.object + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Basic.DiskWriteBytes" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Write (" + r.object + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Manager.UnitsByStateTotal" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: now(), _field: r.state, _value: r._value }))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Manager.UnitsByTypeTotal" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: now(), _field: r.type, _value: r._value }))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.Manager.UnitsByLoadStateTotal" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: now(), _field: r.load_state, _value: r._value }))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.CGroup.CpuUsage" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.type == "total")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {object: "unit", _value: "cpu_ns_per_s"})

panels.title: Top Units by CPU Usage Rate

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.CGroup.MemoryUsage" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.type == "current")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {object: "unit", _value: "memory_bytes"})

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.CGroup.TasksCurrent" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {object: "unit", _value: "tasks"})

bytes = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.CGroup.IOReadBytes" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "read_bytes"})

ops = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.CGroup.IOReadOperations" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "read_operations"})

join(tables: {bytes: bytes, ops: ops}, on: ["object"])
  |> sort(columns: ["read_bytes"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
  |> rename(columns: {object: "unit"})

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._measurement == "io.systemd.Network.Address" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.Network.Address") and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value", "scope"])
  |> rename(columns: {object: "interface", _value: "address"})
  |> sort(columns: ["interface"])

collisions = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.Collisions" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "collisions")

queue_length = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.TransmitQueueLength" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "queue_length")

carrier_changes = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.CarrierChanges" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "carrier_changes")

mtu = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.MTU" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "mtu")

union(tables: [collisions, queue_length, carrier_changes, mtu])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["object"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {object: "interface"})
  |> sort(columns: ["interface"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.ReceiveBytes" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Rx (" + r.object + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.TransmitBytes" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Tx (" + r.object + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.ReceivePackets" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Rx packets (" + r.object + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.TransmitPackets" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Tx packets (" + r.object + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.ReceiveMulticastPackets" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Rx multicast (" + r.object + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.ReceiveErrors" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Rx errors (" + r.object + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.TransmitErrors" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Tx errors (" + r.object + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.ReceiveDropped" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Rx dropped (" + r.object + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "io.systemd.NetworkStatistics.TransmitDropped" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and r.object != "lo")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Tx dropped (" + r.object + ")" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}" and r._field == "value" and r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.Status")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}" and r._field == "value" and r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.Mode")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}" and r._field == "value" and (r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.Status" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.Mode" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.ConfigfileMode" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.Policy" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.PolicyMLS" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.PolicyDenyUnknown" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.PolicyRPMVersion" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.MaxKernelPolicyVersion" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.CheckReqProt" or r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.RootDir"))
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: display(v: r._value)}))
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement:
      if r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.Status" then "status"
      else if r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.Mode" then "mode"
      else if r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.ConfigfileMode" then "config file mode"
      else if r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.Policy" then "policy"
      else if r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.PolicyMLS" then "policy mls"
      else if r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.PolicyDenyUnknown" then "deny unknown"
      else if r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.PolicyRPMVersion" then "policy rpm version"
      else if r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.MaxKernelPolicyVersion" then "max kernel policy version"
      else if r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.CheckReqProt" then "memory protection checking"
      else "root directory"}))
  |> rename(columns: {_measurement: "property", _value: "value"})
  |> keep(columns: ["property", "value"])
  |> sort(columns: ["property"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.PolicyBooleans" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}" and exists r.object)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({boolean: r.object, state: r._value}))
  |> sort(columns: ["boolean"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.UPower.Battery.Charge" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.object }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

vendor = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.UPower.Battery.Vendor" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: display(v: r._value) }))
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "vendor")

model = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.UPower.Battery.Model" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: display(v: r._value) }))
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "model")

state = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.UPower.Battery.State" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: display(v: r._value) }))
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "state")

charge = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.UPower.Battery.Charge" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: display(v: r._value) + " %" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "charge")

energy_full = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.UPower.Battery.EnergyFull" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])

energy_design = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "org.openSUSE.Metrics.UPower.Battery.EnergyDesign" and r._field == "value" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["object", "_value"])

health = join(tables: {full: energy_full, design: energy_design}, on: ["object"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ object: r.object, _value: display(v: 100.0 * r._value_full / r._value_design) + " %" }))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "health")

union(tables: [vendor, model, state, charge, health])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["object"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {object: "battery"})
  |> sort(columns: ["battery"])
